description: This source file contains the implementation of the GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver class, which manages mappings between grain interface types and grain types in Orleans. It includes caching mechanisms and methods for retrieving grain types based on interface types and prefixes, with reliance on cluster manifest data.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver
classes.description: Manages resolution and caching of grain types based on interface types and cluster manifest, with support for prefixes and generic types.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType supporting the provided interface type and prefix, or throws if none found.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType implementing the specified interface type, or throws if not found.

methods.name: TryGetGrainType
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a GrainType for the given interface type, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache of mappings, rebuilding it if outdated.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Builds a cache of interface-to-implementation mappings based on the current cluster manifest.
